title: Bramble Bear
description: Roam a forest valley as a bear. Lope through the pines, swim the river and the lake, catch salmon leaping up the waterfall, raid picnic baskets and give the hikers a story to tell. A free roam with a journal of things to try.
controls: WASD move (camera-relative), Shift run, Space jump, E or click swipe (fish, berries, snacks), R stand and roar, J journal, mouse drag or click-to-lock to look, Esc pause. Touch: left stick walks (push far to run), drag to look, ROAR/SWIPE/JUMP/RUN buttons.
